card.title: Wonderful, It’s Impossible
card.instruction: Celebrate every impossible development as a breakthrough that removes old limitations and creates exciting new problems.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our guest floated through the wall! Wonderful, the door queue is obsolete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She left a hole in the plaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A second entrance! Invite the neighbours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Rain's coming through. We'll need umbrellas at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Indoor umbrella seating! Finally, a seating plan with altitude. I'll move the chandelier.

mechanism: A celebrates wall passage, plaster damage and rain as successive architectural and dining breakthroughs.
confusable: Unlike generic optimism, each impossible development and resulting problem must become a concrete newly exciting possibility.
comparison: The dinner alternative redesigns access and seating around the breach; the kettle alternative redesigns food service around altitude.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
